name: node_load_average_anomaly
title: Fleet 15-minute load average is unusually high
description: Mean 15-minute load average across all nodes (system_cpu_load_average_15m) is above its learned weekday/weekend hour-of-day band in at least 2 of the last 3 five-minute buckets, a sign of run-queue pressure. Unit: runnable threads (load average). Whole fleet; add a k8s_cluster or k8s_node_name filter after install for a per-entity alert (one config per entity).
